baseline_scope: The 112 development baselines are the actual completed 0.36 observation-repair runs, including every failure and regression. Fresh baseline runs load the six saved0.36 runtime modules, preserving paid confirmation, constraint-only observation repair, objective-aware revision experiments, and original terminal recommendation.

policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

accounting: Research acquires 32 actual full objective/constraint vectors once per distinct initial task and shares them across both arms and same-task stable/change profiles. All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.
metrics: final Program and active GP generalization MSE
common misfit, question, fresh validation, and scope adoption sequence
scope: All previous112 cases are development. Three previously unused seeds produce18 ordinary confirmation cases (two noise levels, change and both stable mechanisms) and nine separate stress cases (one observation outlier, outlier followed by change, and objective-only mechanism change with an unchanged constraint). Keep all cases and costs, regardless of whether their outcomes improve.
reuse_accounting: Reuse112 actual baseline runs and all previously paid initial/evaluation observations. Run the new arm on112 development cases and both arms on27 fresh cases:166 new optimizer runs or5312 online calls. Every arm remains32 initial plus32 online calls; goal experiments and recommendation confirmation consume this original budget.
baseline_revision_evidence: Keep the original four-observation batch size and nine-times-frozen-reference threshold. Nonoverlapping actual measurement batches reopen research when both models' batch MSE exceed the threshold and at least two individual rows exceed it for both models. The new scope starts at the earliest such counterexample and retains every subsequently paid row. Eight coverage calls and four fresh validation calls remain inside N64. No change labels, times, or truth values reach the controller.
research_initialization: Fresh initialization uses the saved0.36 claim compiler and unchanged public stratified completion to32 paid full vectors. Both arms share identical initial observations and initial programs. The stress cases share their ordinary noisy StatePolicy initialization.

baseline_method.unchanged: The 0.35 joint confirmation trigger, frozen pre-observation predictions, real repeated control, candidate competition, objective-aware experiment selection, and genuine mechanism revision remain unchanged.
baseline_method.repair_evidence: Only after a same-point confirmation is not supported: at least one frozen original prediction has repeated-target squared error at most the frozen threshold, while squared difference between original and repeated targets exceeds twice that threshold. No simulator disturbance label or evaluator truth enters this decision.
baseline_method.predictor_repair: Retain snapshots of both constraint predictors and their constraint-specific HVD state before assimilating the questioned original observation. Restore those states and replay the actual repeated constraint measurement, excluding the rejected anchor only from constraint fitting and replication statistics. Preserve both objective measurements.
baseline_method.knowledge_scope: Do not replace the executable prior, open a new world scope, or erase history for an observation repair. Keep annotations linking the rejected anchor and its paid confirmation; exclude rejected constraint adoption evidence from subsequent decisions while preserving original evidence and costs.
baseline_method.accounting: All original and repeated observations remain in the full paid N64 ledger. Count predictor repairs, restored model state, snapshot work, replayed constraint updates, and rejected measurements still charged to the budget. There are no extra simulator calls for repair.

outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.
mixed_control: The StatePolicy simulator supplies one +1.0 constraint observation at global stage41 (online9), with unchanged objective and future observations. Starting at global stage45 (online13), both actual objective and constraint mechanisms switch to RZDT2. The runtime receives only public controls and ordinary simulator outputs; changes and disturbances are report-only. This asks whether observation repair preserves sensitivity to later drift.

new_method.independent_goal_models: Fit affine and additive quadratic objective models from the current paid scope, including initial vectors. Compare five cross-validation folds grouped by entire control coordinates, preserving repeated observations in the same fold. Require identifiable designs and cross-validation error lower than a fold-training-mean baseline. Refit after four new paid observations.
new_method.goal_opportunity: Offer a previously unmeasured control only when learned objective gain exceeds the paired-fold standard deviation, the existing objective GP also predicts improvement over its best actually measured feasible control, and the existing robust constraint decision predicts feasibility. Objective exploration is available while constraint research is monitoring; constraint confirmation/research retains priority.
new_method.candidate_pool: Use the learned objective analytic optimum, 33-grid sweeps along each public coordinate through that optimum and the current incumbent, then one further coordinate sweep recentered on the best model-predicted feasible point. No evaluator solution or change label is supplied.
new_method.noisy_recommendation: Within the final four remaining calls, compare the best empirical measured-mean control and best GP-ranked actually measured feasible control. If they differ and their GP objective gap is within two comparison standard deviations, acquire one actual repeat at each control. These measurements are inside the original N64. The cognitive adapter no longer allows a raw noisy empirical objective to override GP terminal ranking.
new_method.accounting: The independent objective-search cap is 20000 compute units, separate from the unchanged 20000 constraint-research cap. Export all objective search fits/predictions, actual GP mean/epistemic/noise prediction counts, goal-exploration and goal-confirmation calls, and observed outcomes. Measured improvement over a noisy incumbent is reported as measured improvement and is not interpreted as true objective gain.
new_method.unchanged: Retain0.36 common-misfit reference, actual constraint confirmation, observation repair, candidate competition, and objective-aware world-revision experiments. All paid observations remain in N64.

objective_only_control: Starting at global stage45, objectives f1/f2 use the upstream RZDT2 mean mechanism, while f3 retains StatePolicyRZDT1. A script-owned StatePolicyRZDT1 subclass composes the upstream deterministic mean methods and inherits the same TestProblem.simulate: one three-output Gaussian draw is one actual observation, with no uncharged second simulator query. Final independent evaluation uses this same hybrid mechanism. The controller receives ordinary controls and measured outputs, without change labels.
